title: Responsible AI for Test Equity and Quality: The Duolingo English Test as a Case Study
findings: The paper makes no findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the study. The concept of fairness is discussed in general terms of cultural sensitivity without specific examples or analyses involving religious groups or beliefs.

measurement_description: The paper discusses an internal 'Fairness and Bias (FAB) review' process for test content. This process aims to eliminate 'culturally sensitive or inaccessible topics that might upset or distract the test-taker'. However, the paper does not explicitly mention measuring bias related to faith or religion as a specific component of this review.
